provenance.derived_from: decompilation only; no emulator, bridge or native run

container_primitive.comment: Identical to the other schema files; repeated so this one stands alone.

node.name: data_off
node.note: 0 means absent; resolved as node + data_off

node.name: table_off
node.note: 0 means absent; resolved as node + table_off

record.size_evidence: 0x82330C58 writes the record at the buffer cursor and passes cursor + 0x0C as the sub-buffer for every maneuver slot

count.location: first word of the resolved data word
count.note: unlike SetBin, ActBin and ComTblBin, which use a u8 count

fields.name: data
fields.note: carries the s32 element count at its first word

fields.name: comtblm
fields.note: each element is one resolved pointer, the ComTblMBin payload

fields.name: comtbl
fields.source: buffer cursor after the comtblm array

record.note: ComTblMBin has no function of its own: it is inlined into ManeuverBin::read and its only trace is the p_data error string.

buffer_accounting.read: reserves count * 4 for the comtblm array, then count * 8 for the comtbl records, then advances by ComTblBin::getReadBuffSize per element
buffer_accounting.getReadBuffSize: returns ((count + count*2) & 0x3FFFFFFF) << 2, which is count * 12, plus the sum of ComTblBin::getReadBuffSize
buffer_accounting.cross_check: count * 12 is exactly the 4-byte and 8-byte arrays read() allocates, computed by a different expression

descent.comment: read() takes two hops per element before it reaches the ComTblBin node.
steps: element = table + child_off[i]; fail-closed 0x82010538 when the index reaches the table count or the node is empty
ComTblBin node = inner table's first child, required present; fail-closed 0x8201056C again

count.location: first byte of the resolved data word

ComTblBin.early_exit: count == 0 returns before the child table is read
ComTblBin.buffer: getReadBuffSize returns count << 2, matching the 4-byte ComBin elements

steps: ObjBin record field `maneuvers` at +0x08, child[1], parser 0x82330C58
that block holds up to 8 maneuver slots, each a ManeuverBin node with a 0x0C record

notes: All 9251 elements complete the two-hop descent to their ComTblBin node; not one stops at an absent p_data, table or first child.
No ManeuverBin declares a negative count or more elements than its table holds.
Element counts per maneuver range from 3 to 15 and never take the value 6.
18 ComTblBin nodes declare zero coms, which is the early exit in ComTblBin::read.

what a maneuver commands; only that it is a list of ComTblM/ComTbl pairs
